projects.name: WVDOT Federal STIP 2027-2032 (STIP)
work_type_values: 24: Widen Roadway (minor widening less than lane width, incl curve widening)
31: Replace (due to condition with no added capacity <12')
projects.notes: WVDOT's mapped federal STIP for FFY 2027-2032 (planned, federally funded). One row per project phase/route segment: Phase_Code prefix tells the phase (e.g. CN = construction; right-of-way and engineering phases have their own codes), Phase_Est_Auth says whether authorization is Estimated or actual, Federal_Fiscal_Year is the programmed year (string, no exact letting date). No cost field. Project is the state project number.

projects.name: WVDOT 2026 Projects - Planned_Projects
projects.notes: WVDOT project-tracker service with three line layers split by stage: 0 = Planned_Projects, 2 = Active_Projects, 1 = Completed_Projects (same schema). ConstructionCode gives detailed work type, Phase_Amount the phase cost, Phase_Start_Date / Phase_End_Date scheduled dates, Fund_Type the funding source. Use layer 0 for planned work.

parcels_statewide.name: WV Parcels (WV GIS Technical Center / WV Property Tax Division)
parcels_statewide.restrictions: Layer description is an 'as is, public service' disclaimer (data prepared for inventory of real property, not a legal survey); no commercial-use or solicitation restriction stated.
parcels_statewide.notes: Statewide, all 55 counties; 1,378,573 of 1,394,081 rows have FullOwnerName. FullOwnerAddress is the owner mailing address in one string; OWNER1/OWNER2 split names; CleanParcelID is a 20-digit id; CountyID/COUNTY are 2-digit county numbers, not names; FullLegalDescription present. No assessed/market value field. MapServer (maxRecordCount 2000), supports query with geometry.

summary: WVDOT STIP FFY2027-2032 and Planned_Projects line layers verify, and the WVU-hosted statewide parcel layer has owner name and mailing address for all counties (no value field).
